summary: Iteration 10 testing: Org Structure CRUD (unlimited depth + cascade delete) and Homeroom Auto-Assign features. Backend pytest 5/5 passed. Frontend Playwright flows all passed as super_admin (add root, add child, edit, cascade delete, no build-error overlay -- confirmed 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' error is fixed via React.createElement) and siswa (view-only, no add/edit/delete controls). Homeroom dropdown assignment persists after reload; siswa sees homeroom-name (read-only) with NO select element. Backend verified: guru becomes able to PATCH class and POST assignment after being assigned homeroom (was 403 before).
critical_code_review_comments: OrgStructure.jsx uses React.createElement for recursive children (line 125) as workaround for babel plugin recursion. Works but is unusual; consider extracting recursive rendering into a separate component with a stable name or memoizing to make it idiomatic JSX.
server.py list_classes N+1 query: for each class, separate find_one on users.homeroom + count_documents. Could be batched via aggregation for larger schools (minor perf).
server.py delete_org _delete_subtree performs recursive per-child delete_one; acceptable for small trees but could be optimized to a single delete_many after collecting descendant ids.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: admin CRUD + cascade delete + no build overlay + homeroom persist + siswa view-only)

seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create TEST_ prefixed org nodes and classes; all cleaned up in-test. UI test created UITEST_ prefixed root+child and deleted them via cascade. Any residual guru.demo homeroom assignment on demo class (persisted intentionally for verification) can remain -- is_demo isolated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter10 covers /api/org CRUD + cascade + role guards, and homeroom auto-assign unlocking guru management. Prior seeded demo org nodes (~7) already existed; tests use unique timestamped names to avoid collisions. Class-name uniqueness enforced -- use timestamp suffix.
